qs.en: The children blew out the candles on the cake.

qs.en: The bakery offers homemade pastries every morning.

qs.en: She bought some Oriental pastries to go with tea.

qs.en: The continental rail network connects many European capitals.

qs.en: France benefits from a continental geographical position that favours exchanges with its neighbours.

qs.en: This region experiences a continental climate, with hot summers and very cold winters.

qs.en: The continental temperatures of this zone vary enormously between seasons.

qs.s: Les pays ___ ont souvent un accès limité aux ressources maritimes.
qs.en: Continental countries often have limited access to maritime resources.

qs.en: European continental philosophy has profoundly influenced modern thought.

qs.s: Les chaînes de montagnes ___ forment une barrière naturelle entre plusieurs pays.
qs.en: The continental mountain ranges form a natural barrier between several countries.

qs.s: Les zones ___ sont généralement moins humides que les régions côtières.
qs.en: Continental zones are generally less humid than coastal regions.

qs.en: At every meeting, the director reiterates his zero-tolerance policy.

qs.en: I reiterate my request because nobody has answered me yet.

qs.en: You always reiterate the same arguments in every debate.

qs.s: Tu ___ ta demande de remboursement pour la troisième fois cette semaine.
qs.en: You are reiterating your refund request for the third time this week.

qs.s: Nous ___ notre engagement à protéger l'environnement.
qs.en: We reiterate our commitment to protecting the environment.

qs.s: Nous ___ nos appels à la paix devant l'assemblée internationale.
qs.en: We reiterate our calls for peace before the international assembly.

qs.s: Vous ___ votre position sans apporter de nouveaux arguments.
qs.en: You reiterate your position without bringing any new arguments.

qs.s: En signant cette pétition, vous ___ votre soutien à cette cause.
qs.en: By signing this petition, you reiterate your support for this cause.

qs.en: The unions reiterate their demands to the government.

qs.s: Les experts ___ leurs mises en garde sur les risques climatiques.
qs.en: The experts reiterate their warnings about climate risks.

qs.s: J'___ mon refus clairement lors de la réunion d'hier.
qs.en: I clearly reiterated my refusal during yesterday's meeting.

qs.s: J'___ ma question au professeur, mais il n'a pas daigné répondre.
qs.en: I reiterated my question to the professor, but he didn't bother to answer.

qs.s: Tu ___ ta plainte auprès du service client plusieurs fois.
qs.en: You have reiterated your complaint to customer service several times.

qs.s: Tu ___ tes conditions hier soir, alors nous avons accepté.
qs.en: You reiterated your conditions last night, so we accepted.

qs.s: Le ministre ___ sa promesse de réforme lors de la conférence de presse.

qs.s: Nous ___ notre demande d'aide financière auprès des autorités.
qs.en: We reiterated our request for financial aid to the authorities.

qs.s: Nous ___ nos excuses lors de la cérémonie officielle.
qs.en: We reiterated our apologies at the official ceremony.

qs.s: Vous ___ votre engagement lors du sommet international la semaine dernière.

qs.en: You reiterated your warnings several times, but without success.

qs.en: The researchers reiterated their results at the scientific colloquium.

qs.en: Every evening, I would reiterate my safety instructions to my team.

qs.s: Tu ___ sans cesse tes inquiétudes concernant ce projet risqué.

qs.s: Le président ___ sa confiance en ses alliés à chaque discours.
qs.en: The president reiterated his trust in his allies at every speech.

qs.s: La porte-parole ___ la même réponse officielle à chaque journaliste.
qs.en: The spokesperson reiterated the same official answer to every journalist.

qs.s: Nous ___ notre opposition à ce projet lors de toutes les réunions du conseil.
qs.en: We kept reiterating our opposition to this project at every council meeting.

qs.s: Nous ___ nos arguments, mais le jury semblait insensible.
qs.en: We kept reiterating our arguments, but the jury seemed unmoved.

qs.s: Vous ___ vos exigences à chaque étape des négociations.
qs.en: You kept reiterating your requirements at every stage of the negotiations.

qs.s: Vous ___ votre mécontentement sans que la direction prenne de mesures.
qs.en: You kept reiterating your dissatisfaction without management taking any action.

qs.s: Les habitants ___ leurs plaintes concernant le bruit chaque semaine.
qs.en: The residents kept reiterating their complaints about the noise every week.

qs.s: Les avocats ___ leurs objections à chaque audience du tribunal.
qs.en: The lawyers kept reiterating their objections at every court hearing.

qs.s: Lors de la prochaine conférence, je ___ mes propositions devant le comité.
qs.en: At the next conference, I will reiterate my proposals before the committee.

qs.s: Je ___ ma position jusqu'à ce qu'on me prenne au sérieux.
qs.en: I will reiterate my position until someone takes me seriously.

qs.s: Tu ___ ta demande auprès du directeur dès demain matin.
qs.en: You will reiterate your request to the director first thing tomorrow morning.

qs.s: Tu ___ tes arguments lors du prochain débat télévisé.
qs.en: You will reiterate your arguments during the next televised debate.

qs.s: Le chef d'État ___ son soutien à l'accord de paix lors du sommet.
qs.en: The head of state will reiterate his support for the peace agreement at the summit.

qs.s: La directrice ___ ses attentes lors de la prochaine réunion d'équipe.
qs.en: The director will reiterate her expectations at the next team meeting.

qs.s: Nous ___ notre appel à la solidarité internationale dans notre prochain communiqué.
qs.en: We will reiterate our call for international solidarity in our next communiqué.

qs.s: Nous ___ nos engagements devant les actionnaires lors de l'assemblée annuelle.
qs.en: We will reiterate our commitments to shareholders at the annual general meeting.

qs.s: Vous ___ votre offre par écrit avant la fin de la semaine.
qs.en: You will reiterate your offer in writing before the end of the week.

qs.s: Vous ___ vos recommandations lors du prochain conseil d'administration.
qs.en: You will reiterate your recommendations at the next board meeting.

qs.s: Les négociateurs ___ leurs propositions lors de la prochaine session.
qs.en: The negotiators will reiterate their proposals at the next session.

qs.s: Les militants ___ leurs exigences devant le Parlement européen.
qs.en: The activists will reiterate their demands before the European Parliament.

qs.s: Si tu ne comprenais pas, je ___ mes explications plus lentement.
qs.en: If you didn't understand, I would reiterate my explanations more slowly.

qs.s: Tu ___ ta demande si tu savais qu'elle n'avait pas été transmise.
qs.en: You would reiterate your request if you knew it hadn't been forwarded.

qs.s: Le gouvernement ___ ses garanties si les syndicats le demandaient.
qs.en: The government would reiterate its guarantees if the unions requested it.

qs.s: La présidente ___ son engagement si les circonstances l'exigeaient.
qs.en: The president would reiterate her commitment if circumstances required it.

qs.s: Nous ___ nos objections si la direction refusait d'écouter.
qs.en: We would reiterate our objections if management refused to listen.

qs.s: Nous ___ notre soutien à cette initiative si elle obtenait plus de fonds.
qs.en: We would reiterate our support for this initiative if it received more funding.

qs.s: Vous ___ vos avertissements si vous pensiez qu'ils n'avaient pas été entendus.
qs.en: You would reiterate your warnings if you thought they hadn't been heard.

qs.en: You would reiterate your request if you knew it had been lost.

qs.en: The representatives would reiterate their demands if the negotiations failed.

qs.en: The experts would reiterate their recommendations if the committee ignored them.

qs.s: Il est essentiel que tu ___ ta demande avant la date limite.

qs.s: Le juge exige que le témoin ___ ses déclarations devant le tribunal.
qs.en: The judge requires that the witness reiterate his statements before the court.

qs.s: L'ambassadeur a tenu à ___ la position ferme de son pays lors du sommet.
qs.en: The ambassador insisted on reiterating his country's firm position at the summit.

qs.s: Le ministre a pris la parole pour ___ l'engagement de son gouvernement envers ses alliés.
qs.en: The minister took the floor to reiterate his government's commitment to its allies.

qs.en: The teacher sometimes has to repeat the same explanations for students who did not understand.

qs.s: L'avocat a dû ___ ses arguments devant la cour d'appel.
qs.en: The lawyer had to repeat his arguments before the court of appeal.
